input.prompt: Use the reference image only for its painting style and light (a painted American comic object: crisp ink outlines, one warm golden key light from above, a green rim light on the left edge, a red rim light on the right edge, black void around, halftone dots only in the deep shadows). Do NOT draw a circuit board or chip. A black metal spiral binding along the top edge. Thick warm cream paper page. Near the top, a wide solid dark bottle-green printed band left completely blank. Under it a thin row of five small blank header cells. Under that, a grid printed in thin black ink lines: exactly five equal columns and exactly three equal rows of large empty square day boxes, all boxes the same size. Every box, the band and the header cells are completely blank and unlettered. A thin red printed rule around the grid. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols anywhere.
